what_it_does: CogSys combines neural networks (deep learning) with symbolic reasoning (formal logic and mathematical inference) in a single optimized system. These hybrid AI workloads face compute heterogeneity and irregular memory access on standard hardware. CogSys redesigns the algorithms using tensor factorization to reduce memory footprint, builds a reconfigurable chip (ASIC) with specialized neuro and symbolic processing elements, and adds a scheduler that balances work between neural and symbolic components for high efficiency.
